title: Senior Solutions Automation Engineer
description: Description Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart. The Opportunity Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on. We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents. In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person. You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right. Your Role Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments. Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it. Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment. Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the team's practice as the tooling changes. Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention. Automate validation as part of building the feature, and catch regressions before a release reaches a customer. Analyze failures, determine root cause, and drive fixes to closure. Demo your work to Solutions Architects, product teams, and customers, and write documentation that other people can actually use. Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues. What You'll Bring Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field. 6+ years building production software, with real depth in at least one role. Python is required. We are looking for production-grade depth and the ability to own a Python codebase that other people depend on. Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic tooling: prompt engineering, agent skills or tool definitions, and testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems. Good judgment about where automation should be deterministic and where an agent adds value, and the discipline to keep the trusted path in code. Strong fundamentals in Object-Oriented Programming, algorithms, data structures, and problem solving. Cloud native delivery experience: containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) and automated CI/CD pipelines. Experience working against REST APIs and building infrastructure as code. Experience with a "systems" product such as storage, virtualization, networking, databases, or operating systems. Skill in debugging complex distributed applications. Excellent written and verbal communication, and the confidence to present technical work to customers and senior stakeholders. A self-starter who can work independently, juggle competing priorities, respect differences, and maintain professionalism under pressure. Nice to Have Additional languages beyond Python: Golang, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Angular, etc. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or comparable infrastructure as code tooling. Background as a platform engineer, SRE, or solutions architect who writes production code. Experience with Jira, GitHub, Artifactory, and modern CI systems. Public evidence of your work: GitHub projects, open source contributions, or published technical writing. Work Arrangement Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. About Lilly At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. The Digital Engagement Tech@Lilly team builds solutions and capabilities for Marketing, Corporate Affairs and Medical organizations globally, and owns the consumer platforms and the governance around them. This role exists because the hardest problems in our space are not solved from a ticket queue. As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will sit with business, medical and marketing teams, understand how they actually work, and build working AI-enabled software with them, fast. You will go from a vague problem to a live product in weeks, then take what you learned and turn it into reusable patterns for the rest of the organization. Role Overview A forward deployed engineer is a senior, hands-on builder who works at the point where technology meets the business problem. You will be embedded with stakeholder teams, own outcomes end to end (discovery, design, build, deploy, adoption), and stay close enough to users to see what works and what does not. This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will spend most of your time building, across the front end, back end and AI layer, while working directly with product owners, system custodians, architects and compliance partners. You will operate with minimal supervision, set patterns and standards for others to follow, and mentor developers and engineers around you. Success means shipping reliable, well-governed solutions that people use, and that move a business metric. What You Will Build Customer-facing and internal web applications in React, Nuxt or Vue, backed by Node.js APIs, built directly with business teams and shipped on short cycles. Agentic and LLM-powered workflows for content, engagement and medical use cases: multi-agent orchestration, tool use and intelligent automation of manual work. RAG and semantic search solutions over enterprise content and data, including embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking and Text2SQL where it fits. Production AI services and APIs that integrate with enterprise data platforms, content systems and downstream product workflows. Reusable patterns, templates, and accelerators that turn a one-off solution into something other teams can adopt. Key Responsibilities Embed and discover Embed with business, medical and marketing teams to understand their workflows, pain points and constraints first-hand. Frame ambiguous problems, decide what is worth building, and be direct about what is not feasible. Prototype quickly, put working software in front of users early, and iterate on their feedback. Build and deliver end to end Design and build full-stack solutions: responsive front ends, API integrations, Node.js services and the data layer behind them. Integrate LLMs, RAG, agents and AI services into products, with evaluation, guardrails and monitoring for quality, latency and cost. Own the delivery lifecycle: scoping and estimation, development, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and support handover. Work with the technical lead and system custodian to keep what you ship maintainable, observable, and secure. Architecture and standards Make architectural decisions that improve efficiency and maintain compliance in a regulated space. Turn what you learn in the field into reusable components, templates, and reference implementations for cross-functional teams. Set and uphold coding standards, review practices and engineering patterns across teams. Responsible AI, security and governance Apply secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles, and build in traceability, grounding, auditability and human oversight. Work with quality, compliance and risk partners, so solutions meet regulatory and enterprise requirements, including content review processes. Maintain clear architecture, design, and support documentation for everything you put into production. Mentoring and influence Provide hands-on technical guidance to developers and engineers, review designs and code, and raise the bar through practical examples. Communicate trade-offs, risks and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders. Bring practical feasibility, scalability, and value considerations into roadmap planning. Required Qualifications 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping production systems end to end. 4+ years building customer-facing or business-facing solutions in close partnership with stakeholders, such as forward deployed, solutions engineering, consulting engineering or embedded product engineering roles. Expert in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript and React, with Nuxt or Vue a plus; strong in responsive design and web standards. Strong back-end experience with Node.js (Express, Koa or Hapi) and API design and integration (REST, GraphQL). 2+ years of hands-on generative AI delivery: LLMs, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows, and evaluation of model outputs. Working proficiency in Python and SQL, and experience with frameworks such as LangChain, DSPy or Hugging Face. Strong experience with unit and integration testing frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, Chai or Jasmine. Experience designing, deploying and operating services on a major cloud (AWS preferred), with CI/CD, containers and monitoring. Strong system design and architecture fundamentals: version control (GitHub), code reviews, and secure, maintainable, observable code. Experience working in Agile teams, including scoping, estimation and backlog ownership. Proven ability to turn ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions with measurable value, and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Qualifications Pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated-industry experience, including working within content review, privacy and compliance processes. Experience with multi-agent systems, tool use, Text2SQL, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and LLM evaluation. Experience with vector databases, lakehouse platforms (such as Databricks), and enterprise AI platforms (such as SageMaker or Azure ML). Experience fine-tuning or adapting models, and optimizing AI systems for quality, latency, throughput and cost. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions and MLflow, or equivalent LLMOps tooling. Experience working across multiple concurrent projects and with stakeholders in different countries and time zones. Experience building developer tooling, internal platforms or accelerators that other teams adopt. Familiarity with web experience platforms, CMS and content operations. title: Engineering Director
description: Engineering Director – Data & AI WHO WE ARE At Maersk, we are on a transformative journey to become the Global Integrator of container logistics, connecting and simplifying our customers' supply chains through technology, data, and innovation. Our SAP landscape is a critical backbone of this vision, and we are accelerating a shift towards modern, scalable, and cost-efficient in-house engineering capabilities. The Position As Engineering Director for Data & AI, you will lead a high-impact organization responsible for modernizing enterprise data engineering, analytics, reporting, and AI-enabled product capabilities. You will keep the current priorities on track while accelerating the shift from fragmented, tool-heavy, and centrally dependent models to scalable, governed, self-service capabilities that reduce overhead and improve business outcomes. You will own the strategy, architecture alignment, and execution of modern data foundations, self-service data query and reporting experiences, and AI-based engineering practices. The role requires deep collaboration across product, platform, SAP, enterprise architecture, security, data governance, and business teams—often beyond direct reporting lines—to influence outcomes at scale. You will play a critical leadership role in reducing dependency on costly enterprise software, enabling engineering-led innovation, and building outcome-based data and AI products that improve decision quality, operational efficiency, customer experience, and user productivity. Key Responsibilities Data Engineering Modernization Define and lead the modernization of data engineering capabilities across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, quality, lineage, and consumption layers. Reduce operational overhead through automation, reusable data patterns, shared engineering standards, and simplified platform architecture. Drive the transition from project-by-project data delivery to scalable, product-oriented data foundations that support analytics, reporting, AI, and decision intelligence use cases. Establish clear engineering practices for data reliability, observability, performance, supportability, and operational resilience across critical data pipelines and products. Self-Service Data & Reporting Enablement Create governed, queryable data layers that enable business and product teams to access trusted data without dependency on costly enterprise software or central reporting bottlenecks. Enable intuitive self-service data discovery, query, reporting, and reuse through standard semantic layers, reusable metrics, data contracts, metadata, and access governance. Modernize reporting capabilities to deliver scalable, self-service dashboards and insights with lower total cost of ownership. Rationalize reporting tools, dashboards, and data marts by promoting shared metrics, standard data products, reusable templates, and fit-for-purpose lower-cost technology choices where appropriate. Ensure reporting outputs are reliable, timely, consistent, secure, and aligned to business-critical decision-making needs. AI-Based Engineering & Data Product Outcomes Drive a strong focus on AI-based engineering, including AI-assisted development, intelligent data quality, automated insight generation, knowledge retrieval, and agentic workflows where they create measurable value. Build impactful data and AI products that solve priority business problems and are measured through adoption, operational improvement, cost reduction, better decisions, or productivity gains. Ensure data products are designed for reuse, discoverability, interoperability, and integration with AI platforms, copilots, agents, and decision intelligence solutions. Establish an outcome discipline where data, analytics, reporting, and AI investments are linked to clear value cases, usage measures, and business benefit realization. Promote responsible, secure, and governed AI adoption across engineering teams, ensuring AI solutions are reliable, explainable where needed, and aligned to enterprise controls. Keeping Existing Priorities on Track Maintain delivery discipline across current data engineering, analytics, reporting, and platform commitments while introducing modernization in a controlled, outcome-focused way. Protect continuity of in-flight priorities by ensuring clear ownership, transparent sequencing, strong stakeholder communication, and measurable delivery milestones. Balance modernization, cost optimization, AI adoption, and business-as-usual reliability so existing business-critical reporting and data services remain stable. Identify and remove execution blockers across teams, vendors, platforms, and governance forums to keep priority outcomes moving at pace. Architecture, Governance & Platform Alignment Partner with enterprise architecture, platform, security, governance, and product teams to define target-state data, analytics, reporting, and AI architecture. Ensure data and AI platforms are aligned with broader cloud, integration, SAP, security, infrastructure, and enterprise architecture strategies. Define guardrails for data governance, AI governance, data quality, privacy, access management, resiliency, cost optimization, and operational controls. Guide build-vs-buy decisions with a pragmatic view of cost, speed, flexibility, engineering leverage, regulatory requirements, and long-term enterprise value. Cross-Organizational Influence Work collaboratively across Product, SAP, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, AI, Data Governance, and business teams beyond direct reporting lines. description: Oracle is seeking an engineering director to build and lead a new Systems Firmware team in Bengaluru. Guide incident triage, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions across firmware, hardware, and software boundaries. Prioritize work by customer impact and ensure timely resolution and clear stakeholder communication. Turn fleet experience into better products. Partner with engineering, operations, and vendors to address recurring defects, improve diagnostics and recovery, and translate customer and operational needs into firmware enhancements. Establish engineering and operational standards. Define and evolve runbooks, escalation processes, maintenance procedures, and firmware validation and deployment practices that improve fleet availability, health, security, and reliability. Drive disciplined execution. Set priorities and manage interdependent initiatives across teams, balancing urgent fleet issues with long-term improvements. Establish measurable outcomes, manage dependencies, and adjust plans as business needs and resources evolve. Champion firmware quality and security. Partner with security and engineering stakeholders to establish secure development practices, clear acceptance criteria, and appropriate testing and release controls. Develop strong global partnerships. Align priorities and ownership across US and India engineering teams, fleet operations, hardware engineering, and external partners. Build productive relationships with ODM/JDM vendors, including Taiwan-based partners. Expand the team’s product development capabilities as it grows. Build the expertise and processes needed to contribute to firmware architecture, platform bring-up, integration, validation, and production readiness for new server and GPU products. Drive continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging firmware technologies, identify team skill gaps, and invest in automation, knowledge sharing, and engineering practices that improve execution and reduce recurring operational work. Required Qualifications Demonstrated success leading systems firmware engineering teams, with experience hiring, coaching, managing performance, and developing senior technical talent. Deep technical expertise in server firmware, with substantial experience in BMC firmware and/or BIOS/UEFI and the ability to lead engineering decisions across both domains. Experience supporting production server environments and leading the investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning firmware, hardware, operating systems, and platform management. Strong technical judgment, including the ability to guide architecture and design reviews, evaluate competing solutions, and connect immediate corrective actions to long-term reliability improvements. Experience establishing operational support practices, including on-call rotations, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, runbooks, and coordination across geographically distributed teams. A record of delivering complex engineering initiatives through clear priorities, resource planning, dependency management, and effective cross-functional execution. Experience applying secure development practices, firmware validation, release management, and controlled deployment processes. Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, manage escalations, and align engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience building a new engineering team or expanding an existing team from operational support into firmware development and product delivery. Experience working directly with ODM/JDM partners on server firmware development, platform bring-up, qualification, and production issue resolution; collaboration with Taiwan-based vendors is particularly relevant. Experience with GPU or accelerated computing platforms and the firmware requirements of large-scale cloud infrastructure. Familiarity with OpenBMC or other BMC firmware stacks, BIOS/UEFI implementations, and server management interfaces and standards such as Redfish and IPMI. Experience improving fleet reliability through firmware telemetry, automated testing, diagnostic tooling, and safe update and recovery mechanisms.
